## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are suggesting.

## Problem Statement / Academic Context
Explain how this feature relates to educational or academic college management workflows, or what DBMS concept it helps demonstrate.

## Proposed Solution / Database Impact
- Will this require changes to the MySQL database schema?
- Are any new tables, constraints, triggers, procedures, or views needed?
- How should the Flask API and React frontend interact with this feature?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or query mockups about the feature request here.
